Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane of a two-lane road in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle drifted across
the center line and struck the front of a southbound vehicle operated by Driver 2. The impact was head-on but
occurred at low speed, and both vehicles came to rest in their respective lanes. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's
seat during the collision, and a Passenger was seated in the front right seat. Both occupants remained in the vehilces
until emergency personnel arrived. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and stiffness consistent with a sudden
forward and backward motion, and the complaint appears plausible given the mechanics of this impact. Driver 2
stated that the collision happened as Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses gave statements that
match that account. Photographs taken at the scene show front-end damage to both vehicles that is consistent with
the reported point and direction of impact. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Rceords
checked at the scene show Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle.
